name: sheet2musicxml
description: Transcribe sheet music images and PDFs into editable MusicXML without requiring a particular notation editor.

interface.longDescription: Transcribe sheet music PDFs, scans, screenshots, and photos into editable MusicXML. Includes source-first review and structural checks for pitches, ties, slurs, chords, and measure lengths. MuseScore and Dorico are optional editors, not dependencies.
capabilities: Transcribe score images and PDFs into MusicXML
Review pitches, accidentals, rhythms, ties, and slurs
Check measure structure and chord-tone overlap
defaultPrompt: Convert this sheet music PDF or image to MusicXML.
Review this MusicXML against the attached score images.
